findings.title: Unparenthesized OR in filter condition when nested in AND combinations
findings.body: A single eventTypeId filter produces `("eventTypeId" = X) OR ("eventParentId" = X)` with no outer parentheses. If a caller embeds this condition without wrapping it, for example `WHERE ${filter} AND other`, the OR binds incorrectly and the filter is bypassed. The `getBaseConditions` and reduce paths happen to wrap it, but `getFilterConditions` is public and returns the bare OR. Wrap the whole expression in parentheses.

findings.title: Team and org scope auth conditions are returned unwrapped
findings.body: The reduce in both the team and org auth builders yields `(A) OR (B)` with no outer parentheses. `getAuthorizationConditions` returns it directly, so a caller appending `AND ...` gets wrong precedence. That could leak bookings outside the authorized scope. `getBaseConditions` wraps it correctly, but the public method is unsafe. Wrap the result in parentheses.

findings.title: Raw SQL test queries a denormalized view whose rows may not exist or may be stale
findings.body: The test selects from "BookingTimeStatusDenormalized" and asserts exact equality on the results. Other bookings from parallel tests could match, and the denormalized data may not reflect new rows if it is a view or is populated asynchronously. Test coverage of the empty-user branch (userIdsFromOrg empty) and the team branch against real data is also missing, so the new conditional-push logic is untested.
